conventional.note: the perceptron is deterministic, so all seeds are identical; the per-seed dispersion is zero by construction

negative_results: Some plastic cells produced no weight change and are retained: [{"axis": "core", "value": "plastic_random", "seeds": 2}]

facts.statement: The BANC t5 graph artifact contains 683,100 verified-sign edges out of 1,535,710 total (Phase 4D).
With eta = 0 the plastic pathway reproduces the fixed-weight simulator spike hashes exactly (Phase 5D).
The fixed-weight simulator is unchanged and remains the oracle for dynamics.
This comparison runs on a synthetic 36-node task graph; it does not read, simulate or alter the BANC connectome.

assumptions: The cue -> action mapping is arbitrary and was declared before the run.
Reward is an external task scalar; its magnitude has no biological unit.
The eligibility trace is a model of short-term tagging with a declared time constant tau_e.
Weight bounds (relative factors and the update clip) are declared modelling choices, not fitted values.
Complete versus Bernoulli(0.5) wiring is a synthetic topology manipulation, not a connectome manipulation.
The structural threshold is the minimum synapse count for an edge to exist (as in the BANC t1/t5/t10 artifacts); it is not a neuronal firing threshold.
A conventional supervised perceptron is an information-privileged reference and is not a matched biological control.
limitations: Success is a conditioned response of a designated action population, not competitive action selection; the selective rate stays near or below the n_cues chance level.
Random wiring has fewer edges and lower total cue input than complete wiring, so the wiring contrast confounds topology with input strength.
The network is small (tens of nodes); no result here tests the BANC connectome or a whole-brain simulation.
Robustness cells are descriptive. They were not corrected for multiple comparisons and are not significance claims.
The unit of replication is a seed; episodes within a seed share one weight trajectory and are not independent samples.
The perceptron sees the correct action label and only bounds what a supervised method can do on this task.
Evaluation uses the same held-out episodes at every checkpoint and does not test unseen cue mappings.
Reward is delivered after a declared delay; no biological dopamine, octopamine or serotonin dynamics were simulated.
independence_statement: The unit of replication is a seed. No statistic pools timesteps or episodes across seeds.
